objective: Load attributed relationship views and durable outcome facts once for one explicit canonical relationship cohort, then derive multiple requested dimension-level outcome projections in memory.

readPlan.attributedViews: at most one getViews call for the canonical cohort
readPlan.outcomeFacts: at most one listForRelationships call for the identical canonical cohort

rules: Relationship IDs are canonically validated and deduplicated while preserving first occurrence order.
Dimensions are validated against the seven canonical acquisition aggregate dimensions and deduplicated while preserving first occurrence order.
Invalid relationship identity or invalid dimension fails before downstream reads.
A non-empty cohort loads attributed views and durable outcome facts concurrently exactly once.
An empty cohort performs zero downstream reads.
Every requested dimension projection is derived in memory from the same loaded views and durable outcome facts.

INS-004B remains sole owner of dimension bucketing, durable outcome validation, distinct relationship counting, bound-does-not-imply-quoted semantics, absent buckets, deterministic bucket order, and exact quote and bind fractions.
No new SQL, persistence schema, persistence mutation, floating-point division, percentage formatting, or rounding is introduced.
explicitlyDeferred: combined economics and outcome reporting DTO
